description: Ask StartupHub.ai to test a product and add it to one of its lists (the "best X" roundups at startuphub.ai/ai-news/reviews). Free in the standard queue (two tests a week). A priority test ($400, run within 14 days) or a private pre-test ($1,500, never published) returns a payment link for a person to pay. The vendor must give a working trial account; it is stored encrypted and never shown. The test runs unannounced with the same kit as every other tool on the list, a fee never changes a score or a position, a low score never removes an entry (the vendor may post one response), and a free re-test follows three months later. Read https://www.startuphub.ai/tested first. Returns the request id and its status page. Free, no credits. Needs a StartupHub.ai API key with credit (pay as you go).

agree.description: true: the account owner accepts the agreement at https://www.startuphub.ai/tested#agreement

contact_email.description: A work address the editor can reach

free_tier_available.description: Whether the product has a free tier (the kit also runs on a fresh free account when it does)

list_url.description: The list page URL or slug on startuphub.ai the product should join

pitch.description: What the product does, 40 to 600 characters, plain text

trial_expires_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the account must stay valid 45 days

trial_login.description: Login details for the trial account (URL, email, password or API key). Stored encrypted.

trial_notes.description: What the trial includes: plan level, limits, anything switched on for the test
